comment: The minimum datasets for core registries are described only at a very high level. They do not state how organisation, service, role, relationship, provenance, identifier, and historical-status information is handled consistently across components.

anchor.note: p.95 l.Lines 273-283 read as the printed page; section 4.3.1 agrees

public.text: The minimum datasets for core registries are described only at a very high level. They do not state how organisation, service, role, relationship, provenance, identifier, and historical-status information is handled consistently across components.
public.suggestedRevision: Define cross-component modelling patterns for identifiers, organisations, locations, roles, relationships, provenance, lifecycle status, effective periods, versioning, and audit metadata.
